hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json,os; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); n=os.path.basename(fp); (print('BLOCKED: Do not edit .env files directly. Use .env.local.example as the template.') or sys.exit(1)) if n.startswith('.env') and not n.endswith('.example') else None"

python3 -c "import sys,json,os; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); n=os.path.basename(fp); (print('BLOCKED: Do not edit lock files directly. Run npm install instead.') or sys.exit(1)) if n in ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'] else None"

python3 -c "import sys,json,os; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); n=os.path.basename(fp); print('WARNING: Editing critical CDK infrastructure stack. Run npx cdk diff after changes to verify impact.') if n in ['computeStack.ts','networkingStack.ts'] else None"

python3 -c "import sys,json,os,subprocess; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); wui=os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'web-ui'); rel=os.path.relpath(fp,wui); subprocess.run(['npx','next','lint','--file',rel,'--quiet'],cwd=wui) if fp.endswith(('.ts','.tsx')) and fp.startswith(wui) else None; sys.exit(0)"
